title: Surreal Flooded Staircase
description: A woman in a flowing pale dress stands on a decaying wooden staircase emerging from dark floodwater, reaching upward with a bottle as papers and objects float around her. The flooded room has purple walls with yellow curtains, framed paintings, and a large circular clock on the ceiling showing 8.7.6 with a falling figure and spotlights beaming down.
prompt: Surreal scene of a woman in a flowing pale grey dress standing barefoot on a broken wooden staircase rising from dark floodwater inside a decaying purple room. She reaches up with a bottle while papers and objects float around her. Yellow curtains with patterns hang on the walls beside framed paintings. A large circular clock on the dark blue ceiling displays 8.7.6 with a falling figure and theatrical spotlights casting dramatic beams through the space.
